units.source_text: 有一天，秋雨霏霏，庭前花草色彩斑斓，露满绿叶。

en.t: One day, autumn rain fell softly, the flowers and grasses before the garden were bright with color, and dew covered the green leaves.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣回想起梅壶的母亲六条妃子在世时种种往事，泪下沾襟，便走到女御的居室里来探望。

en.t: The Genji Inner Minister recalled many things from the time when Rokujo, the mother of the Umetsubo Consort, was still alive; tears wet his collar, and he went to the consort's rooms to visit her.

units.source_text: 他身穿墨色常礼服，借口时势不太平，故而洁身斋戒，实则为藤壶母后祈祷冥福也。

en.t: He wore an ordinary formal robe of ink-black color and used the unsettled state of the times as a pretext for purifying himself and observing abstinence, though in truth he was praying for the repose of Empress Mother Fujitsubo's soul.

units.source_text: 他把念珠藏入袖中，走进帘内来，姿态异常优雅。

en.t: He hid his prayer beads in his sleeve and came inside the blinds, his bearing extraordinarily graceful.

units.source_text: 梅壶女御隔着帷屏亲口和他谈话。

en.t: The Umetsubo Consort spoke with him herself from behind the curtain screen.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣说：“庭前秋花盛开了。

en.t: The Genji Inner Minister said, "The autumn flowers before the garden are in full bloom.

units.source_text: 今年年头不佳，而草木无知，依旧及时开颜发艳，真可怜啊！”

en.t: This has been an inauspicious year, yet the plants and trees know nothing of it and still open their faces in beauty at the proper time. How touching they are!"

units.source_text: 说着，把身子靠在柱上，映着夕照，神彩焕发。

en.t: As he spoke, he leaned against a pillar, and in the evening light his face shone with radiance.

units.source_text: 接着谈到昔年旧事，谈到那天赴野宫访问六条妃子后黎明时依依惜别之状，言下不胜感慨。

en.t: Then he spoke of old memories, and when he came to the morning after he had visited Rokujo at the Nonomiya and they had parted reluctantly at dawn, his words were filled with deep emotion.

units.source_text: 梅壶女御正如古歌所咏“回思往事袖更湿”，也嘤嘤地哭泣起来，样子甚是可怜。

en.t: The Umetsubo Consort, just as in the old poem, "thinking back on the past, my sleeves grow wetter," also began to sob softly, and her appearance was deeply pitiful.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣在帷屏外听她因哭泣而颤动的声音，想见她是个非常温柔优雅的美人。

en.t: From outside the curtain screen, the Genji Inner Minister heard her voice trembling with tears and imagined that she must be an exceptionally gentle and elegant beauty.

units.source_text: 可惜不能见面，胸中焦灼难堪。

en.t: It was a pity that he could not see her face to face, and his heart burned with unbearable longing.
This sort of bad habit was truly detestable!
